# Implement an active social-network ticket

Read [project context](../../docs/social-network/CONTEXT.md), the [active tracker](../../docs/social-network/ticket-tracker.md), the owning [track A](../../docs/social-network/track-a.md) or [track B](../../docs/social-network/track-b.md) definition, and the linked current decisions. Confirm direct prerequisites are complete. Implement only the ticket's scope, run its verification gate, and record exact evidence in the tracker when complete. Use [ticket-writing rules](../../docs/social-network/ticket-rules.md) for ticket edits.

Use [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md) for code conventions. The imported forum requirements and audit are historical references. For a pull request, use the current [PR template](../pull_request_template.md); no separate PR-message file is required.
